=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:656 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The step-level ALERT_MSG_LEVEL declaration reads `${{ vars.ALERT_MSG_LEVEL || 'DEBUG' }}` instead of `${{ env.ALERT_MSG_LEVEL || vars.ALERT_MSG_LEVEL || 'DEBUG' }}`.
  WHY: The smoke fixture's `SILENT` value is overridden, so the new unrouted-reply Telegram WARNING can fire during the release gate.
- tests/test_smoke_alert_silencing_contract.py:70 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The pinned declaration count is four, but the PR adds a fifth step-level declaration.
  WHY: `test_step_level_alert_level_declarations_are_pinned` fails, causing the release gate's `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` job to fail.
- Requirement: "These must never trigger: comments carrying an automation marker (`<!-- ai:… -->`)" — taken verbatim from the linked-issue "Guard against self-triggering" list in the "Fix direction" section. The intent is that ANY comment carrying an `<!-- ai:` marker must not restart clarification, regardless of where `/reclarify` appears in the body.
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/clarify.yml:21` (the job predicate's `(startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/reclarify') || …)` clause), the matching predicate at `.github/workflows/internal-clarify.yml:19`, the matching predicate at `workflow-templates/ai-clarify.yml:19`, the `_rc_is_command` bash classifier in `.github/workflows/clarify.yml` (around line 440 and the requeue step around line 1601), `is_reclarify_command_body` in `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py` (~line 3790), and the `RECLARIFY_COMMAND_JQ_DEF` filter in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` (~line 23).
  Evidence of absence: The job predicate short-circuits on `startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/reclarify')` without consulting either `<!-- ai:` or the plan-comment trailer. `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:is_reclarify_command_body` (lines ~3788-3799) returns True for any body starting with `/reclarify`, with the marker exclusion only applied in the later-line branch. The Bash classifier in `.github/workflows/clarify.yml` (lines ~441-449) uses the same asymmetric check (`[[ "${_rc_first}" == /reclarify* ]] || { … && <!-- ai: not present … }`), and the test cases at `tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py:107-108` explicitly codify the violation: `("/reclarify [auto-requeued-by-poller]\n<!-- ai:reclarify-replay:v1 source=1 -->", True)` and `("/reclarify\n<!-- ai:security-dependency-released:7 -->", True)`. Per the issue's two-bullet "must never trigger" list, both of those comments carry an `<!-- ai:` marker and should evaluate to False; instead they evaluate to True and would re-trigger clarification on a User-author's automation comment.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
